versions.changelog:
- Initial release of bilibili-video-downloader skill.
- Paste any B站 (Bilibili) video link to get a direct, watermark-free download URL.
- Supports batch resolution of multiple links and both www.bilibili.com and b23.tv formats.
- Automatically checks link validity and prompts if non-B站 links are provided.
- Provides both video and cover image download URLs.
